claims.supported: STS semantic/state/causal contracts correspond to real defect classes previously found in this 154-story corpus; STS 4.2 closes repeated modeling gaps.
claims.not_supported: prospective automatic detection rate, end-to-end screenplay quality gain, audience preference, or causal attribution of prior revisions to STS.

threats_to_validity: The field lens classification is not blinded and is retrospective.
KEEP is not treated as proof that a story is defect-free.
The corpus contains short prose stories, not 154 controlled screenplay generations.
Risk-lens frequencies are analyst classifications, not precision/recall metrics.
Some earlier editorial work used related narrative-state ideas, so historical evidence is not fully independent of the broader design lineage.
